# Stable Diffusion v1.2

CompVis · released 2022-08 · 0.86B params · creativeml-openrail-m

**score 23.6** ±2.7 · #106 of 108 · from 2 benchmark results across 2 sources · \* thinly tested, treat the rank as provisional

Score within the [LMArena text-to-image](https://whatmodel.sh/image?set=lmarena-image) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
version              needs  score
fp16 · nvidia only  ~2.6GB   23.6
</pre>

```sh
# fp16 · nvidia only
uv run --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with torch python -c "import torch; from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline; p=StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-2', torch_dtype=torch.float16).to('cuda'); p('a cat holding a sign').images[0].save('out.png')"
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
